title: Low angle (looking up)
purpose: The camera is below eye level. Makes a figure loom and a place feel taller.
keeps: the angle: the plate is warped by the studio before the engine sees it, then measured
the place (the same plate, from a different camera)
cannot: the angle in a place with no straight verticals (a harbour of masts cannot be measured)
the figure seen from below (the pack's low view is foreshortened and the compositor sizes by total height, so it lands as a big head on a short body - the place is angled, the person is not)
measured: asked +0.32, the plate measures +0.30; delivered pitch is exact to 0.02 on every place the ruler can read
hint: The camera is below eye level. Makes a figure loom and a place feel taller.
